aboutGame.title: What is Haze Seas?
paragraphs: Haze Seas is the reworked version of Haze Piece by Haze Studios on Roblox. It keeps the anime pirate RPG loop players search for most: quests, fruits, swords, fighting styles, bosses, races, bounty, and island progression.

Players should treat Haze Seas as a live-update game. The Roblox page and event page are the safest anchors for release timing, while Discord and YouTube are the best places to verify fresh codes, maintenance notices, and rework showcases.

items.question: What is Haze Seas?
items.answer: Haze Seas is the reworked version of Haze Piece by Haze Studios on Roblox. It is an anime pirate Action RPG featuring fruits, swords, fighting styles, races, bosses, and island progression.

items.question: Is Haze Seas free to play?
items.answer: Yes, Haze Seas is a free-to-play Roblox experience. You can join via the official Roblox page and start playing immediately.

items.question: How do I redeem codes in Haze Seas?
items.answer: Open the Roblox game, find the in-game Shop or Codes menu, enter the code, and confirm. Rewards such as EXP boosts, Race Spins, Gems, and Stat Refunds are added to your account instantly.

items.question: What is the best fruit in Haze Seas?
items.answer: Post-release testing is still underway. Dragon, Dough, Leopard, Venom, Soul, and Phoenix fruits are the most commonly cited S-tier candidates for grinding, bosses, and PvP.

items.question: Where do I find active codes for Haze Seas?
items.answer: The Codes page on this wiki tracks codes from the official Roblox description, official Discord announcements, and official Haze Studios YouTube channel. Always verify codes in-game before relying on them.
